label: Bootstrap configuration (Sync Gateway)
type: the node-specific, restart-required configuration surface (config-group ID, Couchbase Server connection string, node-level TLS/auth flags) that Sync Gateway reads at startup before any persistent, per-database configuration is fetched.
note: Sibling of sgw:persistent-configuration and sgw:legacy-pre-3-config as the third configuration-mode/tier this round found - node-level and always restart-required, as against database-level persistent config, which Sync Gateway can auto-restart itself for.
